headline: Uzbekistan Gold Exports Plunge 79% as Capital Inflows Support Domestic Currency
summary: Gold exports from Uzbekistan fell 79% according to report data from ING. Strong foreign capital inflows helped support the exchange rate of the domestic currency, the soum, during the period.
why: Uzbekistan is a major global producer and exporter of gold. Variations in state gold sales significantly impact national foreign exchange reserves, trade balances, and central bank monetary balances.
